description: This shell script retrieves and validates an account ID from system configuration sources, logging the process and handling validation.

methods.name: echo_time
methods.description: Logs the current timestamp along with a message indicating the function call source.

methods.name: check_accountid
methods.description: Validates the provided account ID for length, alphanumeric characters, and absence of special characters, and logs the validation result.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the account ID from system config or fallback method, then validates and logs the process.
